DARKSKY NEXUS w036 Connection Setup
s server startup s WS API ready s device release
Use this mode when:
▸ SDRConnect is already running on this Mac
▸ SDRConnect is connected to an nRSP-ST on your LAN
▸ SDRConnect is connected to a local RSPdx via USB

NEXUS will connect to SDRConnect on
ws://127.0.0.1:5454 (or use --sdr HOST for remote SDRConnect)

NEXUS only ever talks to SDRConnect itself over this WebSocket — it never accesses RSP hardware directly, and it can only choose between devices that SDRConnect's own device list already reports. If a USB RSP is plugged in but doesn't show up here, that's SDRConnect not detecting it (check its own device dropdown, or that nothing else has claimed it) — NEXUS has nothing to offer a choice on until SDRConnect lists it. Once SDRConnect does see it, NEXUS auto-prefers a directly-connected USB RSP over a networked nRSP-ST — or pick explicitly below if you want the same choice every time regardless of what's plugged in.
Launch SDRConnect automatically at NEXUS startup
Default is None — NEXUS just connects to whatever's already running, exactly like before. Pick Headless or Full GUI to have NEXUS launch SDRConnect itself instead of you starting it manually.
Device preference (USB vs nRSP-ST) is now set via the connection picker shown at startup — reopen it any time from the Choose connection control in the top bar.
